findings.reason: §17 must either extend `_count_unembedded` to return the full `{total, embedded, pending}` aggregate (the shape its caller actually needs) or the plan should say the code phase keeps its aggregate query and only the shared predicate clause moves, otherwise a second fetch is added and the duplication §17 exists to remove survives.
findings.text: §17 states "the code phase's pending count calls `_count_unembedded` instead of carrying its own copy", but `_count_unembedded` (embed_worker.py:222-262) returns a single `count(n)`, whereas the code phase's hand-rolled query at imas_codex/discovery/code/parallel.py:472-497 returns three aggregates in one round-trip — `total_chunks` (`count(cc)`), `embedded_chunks` (`count(cc.embedding)`) and `pending`. Replacing only the pending sub-count with `_count_unembedded` leaves the code phase carrying its own query for the other two and adds a second query for one datum, so §17's claim of "one place to widen" is not reached as written

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — every proposed change extends an existing deep module rather than adding surface: §16/§18 hide the facility predicate behind `build_vector_search(prefilter_clauses=…)` (`imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py:17`), §17 extends the one shared `embed_worker`, and the §3 decision was resolved to the existing DOCUMENTS relationship and a `fronts_database` property instead of a new edge.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §17 names the right owner (`_count_unembedded` in `imas_codex/discovery/base/embed_worker.py`) but that owner returns a bare count and cannot absorb the code phase's three-aggregate statistic, so the stated consolidation leaves the code phase's hand-rolled query partly in place.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied figures public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; no section adds to any family (§16 and §18 add no annotation key beyond §12's, §17 adds no `--reset-to` value, §14 reuses existing `discover paths` / `discover code --path-prefix` options), and each section states what it retires.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan names the mechanism each section extends (§12's `GraphClient.ensure_vector_indexes` and `build_vector_search`, §17's `imas_codex/discovery/base/embed_worker.py`, §3's `WikiChunk`-DOCUMENTS edge and `WikiPage.fronts_database`) and §14 reuses the existing `discover paths` pipeline plus the `discover code --path-prefix` scope, adding no subsystem.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section adds a wrapper layer; §16/§18 move predicates onto an existing builder, §17 widens an existing owner, and §14 runs an existing CLI pipeline, so there is no new forwarding layer needing an extend-instead justification.
